entries.title: Sun in the 1st house
entries.body: The Sun on the ascendant puts identity, vitality and self-direction at the centre of life. Classical texts link it to a strong constitution, pride and a wish to lead, alongside a sharp temper and heat in the body. In Mesha or Simha it is at its most confident; in Tula it has to learn to share the stage.

entries.title: Sun in the 2nd house
entries.body: The Sun in the house of wealth, speech and family ties self-worth to earnings and to the voice. Tradition reads authoritative speech, money from government or senior figures, and friction over family resources. The lesson is to let dignity show in how resources are handled, not in rigid pronouncements.

entries.title: Sun in the 3rd house
entries.body: A natural malefic in an upachaya house of effort tends to improve with time. Courage, initiative, clear communication and success through one's own exertion are the classical themes, and siblings may be few or relations formal. This is a supportive placement for writing, media and enterprise.

entries.title: Sun in the 4th house
entries.body: The Sun in the house of home, mother and inner peace can make domestic life a place of duty rather than rest. Classical readings mention restlessness of mind and property linked to the father or the state. Contentment comes from making the home a base of purpose instead of control.

entries.title: Sun in the 5th house
entries.body: The Sun in the house of intelligence, creativity and children gives a proud, principled mind and an interest in leadership, politics or dharma. Texts caution about fewer children or delay, and about strain with them. Creative work and teaching are natural outlets for its light.

entries.title: Sun in the 6th house
entries.body: An upachaya placement, and classically among the Sun's best. It is read as victory over rivals, good resistance to disease, and success in service, medicine, law or administration. Enemies may exist but tend to be overcome. Watch digestion and heat-related ailments.

entries.title: Sun in the 7th house
entries.body: The Sun opposite the ascendant brings ego and authority into partnership. Tradition reads a dignified or status-conscious spouse and friction when both want to lead. Partnerships improve when respect runs both ways. Public dealings and contracts with officials are emphasised.

entries.title: Sun in the 8th house
entries.body: The Sun in the house of hidden matters and transformation points to research, the occult, insurance or inheritance. Classical readings urge care for eyesight and vitality and note sudden changes around authority figures. Resilience grows through crises that are met with honesty.

entries.title: Sun in the 9th house
entries.body: The Sun in the house of dharma, the father and fortune gives strong principles, respect for tradition and an interest in philosophy or law. Some texts note a principled or distant father, or differences with him. Fortune tends to come through ethical leadership and teachers.

entries.title: Sun in the 10th house
entries.body: Here the Sun has directional strength (dig bala), a classic signature of career prominence. Authority, recognition, work with government or senior roles, and a reputation built on competence are the themes. The shadow side is identifying so fully with status that rest is neglected.

entries.title: Sun in the 11th house
entries.body: The Sun in the house of gains is traditionally very favourable. It is read as income through influential people and fulfilment of ambitions, with networks that include people in authority. Elder siblings or friends may be prominent. Gains tend to rise steadily over life.

entries.title: Sun in the 12th house
entries.body: The Sun in the house of loss, solitude and foreign lands turns the life-force inward. Classical themes include expenses tied to status, work abroad or in institutions, and a spiritual search. Eyesight and sleep deserve care. Service done without seeking credit is the constructive expression.

entries.title: Moon in the 1st house
entries.body: The Moon on the ascendant makes feeling visible: a receptive, changeable and often attractive presence that is sensitive to surroundings. A waxing, well-placed Moon is read as popularity and a gentle nature; a weak Moon as moodiness. It is strongest in Vrishabha or Karka.

entries.title: Moon in the 2nd house
entries.body: The Moon in the house of speech, food and family gives a pleasant voice, attachment to family and income that rises and falls with the lunar tides. Texts associate it with wealth through the public, liquids, food or women. Emotional security is closely tied to savings.

entries.title: Moon in the 3rd house
entries.body: The Moon in the house of effort and communication gives a restless, curious mind drawn to writing, travel and media. Relations with siblings are emotionally significant. Courage comes in waves, so consistent practice steadies the natural talent for expression.

entries.title: Moon in the 4th house
entries.body: The Moon has directional strength in the 4th, its own natural house of home and mother. Classical readings give emotional contentment, a close bond with the mother, comforts, property and vehicles. The heart's peace depends strongly on a settled home.

entries.title: Moon in the 5th house
entries.body: The Moon in the house of intelligence and children gives an imaginative, sensitive mind and a warm relationship with children. It is traditionally favourable for creativity, devotion and counselling. Speculative decisions should not be made on mood alone.

entries.title: Moon in the 6th house
entries.body: The Moon in the house of illness, debt and service makes the mind a factor in health. Texts caution about digestion and worry, and the placement suits nursing, care work and service professions. Emotional boundaries with co-workers and a daily routine are protective.

entries.title: Moon in the 7th house
entries.body: The Moon in the house of partnership gives a need for emotional companionship, a caring or popular partner and success in dealing with the public. Moods can fluctuate in relationships. Mutual reassurance and clear agreements keep partnerships steady.

entries.title: Moon in the 8th house
entries.body: The Moon in the house of transformation makes the emotional life deep and private. It is linked to intuition, interest in hidden matters and emotional ups and downs. Classical texts ask for care of health in the Moon's periods. Therapy, research and spiritual practice give its depth a constructive channel.

entries.title: Moon in the 9th house
entries.body: The Moon in the house of dharma and fortune gives a devotional, principled heart, love of pilgrimage or travel, and support from the mother's side. It is read as good fortune and popularity when the Moon is strong. Beliefs may evolve through life.

entries.title: Moon in the 10th house
entries.body: The Moon in the house of career brings public visibility and work involving people, care, hospitality or trade in liquids and food. Reputation can fluctuate with public mood. Classical texts regard a strong Moon here as success and recognition.

entries.title: Moon in the 11th house
entries.body: The Moon in the house of gains gives a wide social circle, supportive friends, and income through the public or through women. It is traditionally among the Moon's best placements for fulfilment of wishes. Gains come in cycles, and generosity keeps them flowing.

entries.title: Moon in the 12th house
entries.body: The Moon in the house of solitude gives a rich inner life, vivid dreams and a need for retreat. Expenses may track mood. Classical readings mention life or work away from the birthplace and attraction to spiritual practice. Rest and sleep hygiene matter here.

entries.title: Mars in the 1st house
entries.body: Mars on the ascendant gives energy, courage, a competitive drive and a quick temper. Classical texts note scars or injuries to the head and a forceful manner. It is one of the Mangala dosha placements for marriage matching. Physical activity is the healthiest outlet for this heat.

entries.title: Mars in the 2nd house
entries.body: Mars in the house of speech and family can make words sharp and finances active: earning through property, technology or bold ventures, but also impulsive spending. It is counted in some traditions for Mangala dosha. Careful speech protects family harmony.

entries.title: Mars in the 3rd house
entries.body: Mars is at home in this upachaya house of courage. Tradition reads valour, initiative, physical prowess and success through personal effort. Younger siblings may be few or the relationship competitive. Sport, the military, engineering and entrepreneurship suit it.

entries.title: Mars in the 4th house
entries.body: Mars in the house of home can bring energy to property and vehicles but friction into domestic peace. It is a Mangala dosha placement, and texts mention restlessness and disputes over land. Channel the drive into building or renovating rather than into arguments.

entries.title: Mars in the 5th house
entries.body: Mars in the house of intelligence gives a sharp, strategic and competitive mind. Classical texts caution about impulsive speculation and about concerns with children. Sport, technical study and leadership of young people are constructive uses.

entries.title: Mars in the 6th house
entries.body: An excellent placement for a natural malefic. Mars in the 6th is read as victory over enemies and disease, competitive success, and aptitude for surgery, the police, the military or law. Heat and inflammation are the areas of health to watch.

entries.title: Mars in the 7th house
entries.body: Mars in the house of partnership is a principal Mangala dosha placement. It brings passion and energy into relationships along with potential conflict or a dominant partner. Dignity and aspects modify it greatly. Shared goals and physical activity together help.

entries.title: Mars in the 8th house
entries.body: Mars in the house of sudden events asks for care with accidents, surgery and impulsive risk. It is also a Mangala dosha placement. Constructively, it gives courage in crises and an aptitude for research, investigation or emergency work. Inheritance matters may involve disputes.

entries.title: Mars in the 9th house
entries.body: Mars in the house of dharma gives zeal for beliefs and a pioneering approach to higher learning. It can bring friction with the father or with teachers. Classical texts warn against dogmatism. Principles defended with fairness become a source of fortune.

entries.title: Mars in the 10th house
entries.body: Mars has directional strength in the 10th, a strong career signature. It gives an action-oriented profession, command, engineering, surgery, the police or property, and the drive to reach authority. The need is to temper impatience with superiors.

entries.title: Mars in the 11th house
entries.body: Mars in the house of gains is classically favourable: income through effort, property or technical skill, ambitions pursued vigorously, and influential friends. Relations with elder siblings may be competitive. Gains follow decisive action.

entries.title: Mars in the 12th house
entries.body: Mars in the house of loss can scatter energy through expenses, hidden conflicts or restless sleep. It is counted in Mangala dosha by some. Constructive outlets include work abroad, in hospitals or institutions, and disciplined spiritual practice such as yoga.

entries.title: Mercury in the 1st house
entries.body: Mercury has directional strength on the ascendant. It gives a quick, youthful, articulate and adaptable personality with a gift for learning, humour and trade. Classical texts praise intelligence and a long-lasting youthful look. Nervous energy needs grounding.

entries.title: Mercury in the 2nd house
entries.body: Mercury in the house of speech and wealth gives eloquence, skill with numbers, and earnings through trade, teaching, writing or accounts. It is traditionally a sign of wealth gained through intellect. Truthful speech strengthens it.

entries.title: Mercury in the 3rd house
entries.body: Mercury in the house of communication is well suited to writing, media, marketing and short travel. It gives a curious, skilful mind and active relations with siblings and neighbours. The caution is to finish what is started rather than chase every idea.

entries.title: Mercury in the 4th house
entries.body: Mercury in the house of home and education gives a studious household, good foundational learning and a mind that works best in a settled environment. Property or vehicles may be connected with trade. It is classically favourable for scholarship.

entries.title: Mercury in the 5th house
entries.body: Mercury in the house of intelligence is a strong signature for learning, analysis, advisory roles and skill in mantra or mathematics. Classical texts connect it with counsel to those in power. Creativity shows through wit, games and teaching.

entries.title: Mercury in the 6th house
entries.body: Mercury in the house of service and dispute gives skill in argument, analysis, accounts, law and healthcare administration, and an ability to outwit rivals. Nervous tension and skin or digestive sensitivity are worth attention. A daily routine calms the mind.

entries.title: Mercury in the 7th house
entries.body: Mercury in the house of partnership favours business partnerships, negotiation, contracts and a youthful, communicative partner. Classical texts associate it with knowledge of law and commerce. Clear conversation is the heart of relationship success.

entries.title: Mercury in the 8th house
entries.body: Mercury in the house of hidden matters gives a researching, probing mind drawn to astrology, psychology, investigation or finance. It is traditionally considered one of the better placements in the 8th, linked to a long life and a good reputation. Worry should not be allowed to run unchecked.

entries.title: Mercury in the 9th house
entries.body: Mercury in the house of dharma gives a philosophical, questioning intellect and aptitude for higher study, publishing and teaching. Beliefs are reasoned rather than inherited. Classical readings link it to fortune through learning.

entries.title: Mercury in the 10th house
entries.body: Mercury in the house of career favours professions in communication, commerce, IT, accounting, writing or consulting. It brings versatility and a reputation for competence. Classical texts see success in trade and administration.

entries.title: Mercury in the 11th house
entries.body: Mercury in the house of gains brings income through intellect, trade and networks. Friends tend to be clever or young, and several streams of income are possible. It is traditionally a wealth-giving placement.

entries.title: Mercury in the 12th house
entries.body: Mercury in the house of solitude gives an imaginative, private mind suited to research, foreign languages and writing done in seclusion. Texts caution about expenses through careless contracts and restless thinking at night. Meditation and journaling help.

entries.title: Jupiter in the 1st house
entries.body: Jupiter has directional strength on the ascendant, one of the most protective placements in the chart. It gives wisdom, optimism, dignity, good counsel and respect from others. Its aspects on the 5th, 7th and 9th support children, partnership and fortune. Weight gain from comfort is the classical caution.

entries.title: Jupiter in the 2nd house
entries.body: Jupiter in the house of wealth and speech gives truthful, sweet speech, family prosperity, knowledge of scripture or learning, and savings that tend to grow. It is classically a strong sign of wealth. Teaching, finance and counselling suit it.

entries.title: Jupiter in the 3rd house
entries.body: Jupiter in the house of effort is traditionally modest in effect for a benefic. Some texts read reluctance to exert oneself, others wisdom in communication and supportive siblings. Writing on meaningful subjects and teaching turn it to advantage.

entries.title: Jupiter in the 4th house
entries.body: Jupiter in the house of home and heart gives contentment, a good education, comforts, vehicles and property, and a respected mother. It is a kendra placement that supports inner peace and a harmonious household.

entries.title: Jupiter in the 5th house
entries.body: Jupiter in its natural house of children and intelligence gives wisdom, devotion, good counsel and interest in teaching. Classical texts note that it blesses the house's matters but can bring delay with children, depending on the sign. It strongly supports past merit (purva punya).

entries.title: Jupiter in the 6th house
entries.body: Jupiter in the house of service and dispute helps a person win through fairness and resolve conflicts wisely. Texts caution about weight, liver and sugar-related health, and about taking on others' debts. Service professions, law and healing suit it.

entries.title: Jupiter in the 7th house
entries.body: Jupiter in the house of partnership is classically favourable for a wise, principled or well-placed partner and for honourable business dealings. It aspects the ascendant, strengthening character. Expectations of a partner may be idealistic.

entries.title: Jupiter in the 8th house
entries.body: Jupiter in the house of longevity is traditionally protective of life span and gives interest in esoteric knowledge, research and spiritual transformation. Inheritance or insurance may play a role. Growth comes through facing hidden matters with wisdom.

entries.title: Jupiter in the 9th house
entries.body: Jupiter in its natural house of dharma and fortune is among the strongest blessings in the chart. It brings good fortune, devotion, respect for teachers, a supportive father, and aptitude for philosophy, law and higher learning.

entries.title: Jupiter in the 10th house
entries.body: Jupiter in the house of career brings respected, ethical work in teaching, advising, law, finance or religious and educational institutions. Recognition follows integrity. Some texts note that the house's benefits unfold gradually rather than suddenly.

entries.title: Jupiter in the 11th house
entries.body: Jupiter in the house of gains is classically excellent for income, fulfilment of desires, wise and influential friends, and support from elder siblings. Gains grow through generosity and good counsel.

entries.title: Jupiter in the 12th house
entries.body: Jupiter in the house of liberation gives a spiritual inclination, generosity, charitable spending and connection with foreign lands or ashrams. Classical texts read good sleep and a peaceful end to life's journey. Expenses tend to go to worthy causes.

entries.title: Venus in the 1st house
entries.body: Venus on the ascendant gives charm, grace, attractiveness, artistic taste and love of comfort. It supports harmonious relationships and a pleasant nature. Classical texts praise it for a happy life, with a caution against indulgence.

entries.title: Venus in the 2nd house
entries.body: Venus in the house of wealth and speech gives sweet speech, wealth through arts, beauty, luxury or finance, good food and family happiness. It is traditionally a very comfortable placement for accumulating resources.

entries.title: Venus in the 3rd house
entries.body: Venus in the house of communication gives artistic expression through writing, music, design and media, and affectionate relations with siblings. Initiative is gentle rather than forceful, and creative collaborations flourish.

entries.title: Venus in the 4th house
entries.body: Venus has directional strength in the 4th. It gives a beautiful home, vehicles, domestic happiness, comforts and a loving bond with the mother. It is classically among the best indicators of inner contentment and luxury.

entries.title: Venus in the 5th house
entries.body: Venus in the house of creativity and romance gives artistic talent, joy in children, romantic nature and success in entertainment or the arts. Classical readings associate it with comfort and pleasures of the mind.

entries.title: Venus in the 6th house
entries.body: Venus in the house of service and conflict is traditionally uneasy for relationships and comforts. It brings friction with partners, or pleasures that turn into habits. Constructively, it suits beauty, hospitality, healthcare and service professions done with care.

entries.title: Venus in the 7th house
entries.body: Venus in its natural house of partnership gives a charming, attractive partner and strong desire for companionship, and it supports success in business dealing with the public. Classical texts caution against excessive sensuality. Harmony and fairness are its gifts.

entries.title: Venus in the 8th house
entries.body: Venus in the house of hidden matters can bring gains through a partner, inheritance or joint finances, along with intense, private attachments. It is traditionally better than most planets in the 8th. Care with reproductive health and secrecy in love is advised.

entries.title: Venus in the 9th house
entries.body: Venus in the house of fortune gives luck through a partner, love of travel, refined values and devotion expressed through art or beauty. Classical texts read prosperity and a gracious outlook.

entries.title: Venus in the 10th house
entries.body: Venus in the house of career favours professions in the arts, fashion, beauty, hospitality, diplomacy or luxury goods, and a pleasant public image. Recognition comes through grace and collaboration.

entries.title: Venus in the 11th house
entries.body: Venus in the house of gains is classically excellent: income through arts, women or luxury, many friends, and fulfilment of desires for comfort. Social life is rich and supportive.

entries.title: Venus in the 12th house
entries.body: Venus is traditionally well placed in the 12th, the house of bed-pleasures and private comfort. It gives enjoyment, spending on luxury and travel, and artistic or spiritual refinement. Classical texts read comfortable living, with a caution against extravagance.

entries.title: Saturn in the 1st house
entries.body: Saturn on the ascendant gives seriousness, endurance, patience and a sense of responsibility from a young age. Early life may feel heavy, and results tend to come with maturity. In Tula, Makara or Kumbha the placement is dignified and strong. Discipline is the key to its reward.

entries.title: Saturn in the 2nd house
entries.body: Saturn in the house of wealth and speech makes accumulation slow but durable. Speech is measured, sometimes blunt, and family responsibilities may come early. Classical texts note delayed but lasting savings through sustained effort.

entries.title: Saturn in the 3rd house
entries.body: Saturn in the upachaya 3rd house is classically favourable. It gives perseverance, courage that grows with age, practical skill and success through persistent effort. It is well suited to long projects, crafts and technical work.

entries.title: Saturn in the 4th house
entries.body: Saturn in the house of home can bring a sense of duty or austerity at home, delayed property and emotional reserve. It is favourable for land, real estate and old buildings. Inner peace grows by building structure patiently.

entries.title: Saturn in the 5th house
entries.body: Saturn in the house of children and intelligence gives a serious, practical, deep-thinking mind. Texts note delay or responsibility concerning children, and caution in speculation. Disciplined study and long-term creative projects are its strengths.

entries.title: Saturn in the 6th house
entries.body: Saturn in the upachaya 6th house is among its best placements. It gives defeat of enemies through persistence, capacity for hard work and service, and success in law, labour, healthcare or administration. Chronic conditions need steady care.

entries.title: Saturn in the 7th house
entries.body: Saturn has directional strength in the 7th. It gives loyalty and duty in partnership, often a mature or serious partner, and possible delay in marriage. Relationships deepen with time and commitment. Business partnerships reward reliability.

entries.title: Saturn in the 8th house
entries.body: Saturn, the natural karaka of longevity, in the 8th is traditionally read as a long life, though with chronic concerns to manage. It gives endurance through hardship and interest in research, the occult or hidden structures. Patience with slow transformation is its lesson.

entries.title: Saturn in the 9th house
entries.body: Saturn in the house of dharma gives a practical, sometimes unconventional philosophy, respect for tradition earned through experience, and fortune that ripens late. Relations with the father or teachers may be formal. Service to others is itself dharma here.

entries.title: Saturn in the 10th house
entries.body: Saturn in the house of career gives slow, steady rise through hard work, positions of lasting authority, and success in administration, law, engineering, mining or public service. Classical texts caution about downfall from misuse of power. Integrity keeps the climb secure.

entries.title: Saturn in the 11th house
entries.body: Saturn in the house of gains is classically excellent. It gives steady, growing income over time, older or influential friends, and fulfilment of long-held ambitions. Gains may come later in life but prove durable.

entries.title: Saturn in the 12th house
entries.body: Saturn in the house of solitude gives a capacity for renunciation, work in isolation, hospitals or abroad, and controlled expenses. Texts caution about loneliness and sleep issues. Disciplined spiritual practice turns this into quiet strength.

entries.title: Rahu in the 1st house
entries.body: Rahu on the ascendant amplifies self-image and ambition, giving an unconventional, magnetic and restless personality drawn to the new or foreign. Identity may feel in flux. Grounding practices and honesty about motives steady its intensity.

entries.title: Rahu in the 2nd house
entries.body: Rahu in the house of wealth and speech gives a hunger for resources, unusual sources of income and persuasive or exaggerated speech. Family life may be unconventional. Diet and truthful speech are areas for mindful attention.

entries.title: Rahu in the 3rd house
entries.body: Rahu in the upachaya 3rd house is traditionally strong. It gives boldness, media or technology skills, success through daring initiatives and a fearless communicator. It is one of Rahu's best placements for worldly achievement.

entries.title: Rahu in the 4th house
entries.body: Rahu in the house of home can bring restlessness about belonging, frequent relocation, foreign residence or unconventional property. Classical readings ask for attention to the mother's wellbeing and to inner peace. Building a sense of home within is the remedy.

entries.title: Rahu in the 5th house
entries.body: Rahu in the house of intelligence gives an inventive, unconventional mind and interest in technology, speculation or foreign learning. Texts caution about concerns with children and impulsive speculation. Channel ambition into original creative work.

entries.title: Rahu in the 6th house
entries.body: Rahu in the upachaya 6th house is classically very favourable. It gives the ability to overcome rivals, success in competitive fields and aptitude for medicine, law or technology. Unusual health issues deserve proper diagnosis.

entries.title: Rahu in the 7th house
entries.body: Rahu in the house of partnership brings attraction to unconventional or foreign partners and intense, sometimes unstable relationship dynamics. It favours international business. Clear agreements and realistic expectations protect partnerships.

entries.title: Rahu in the 8th house
entries.body: Rahu in the house of hidden matters draws a person to research, the occult and secret knowledge, and to sudden events or windfalls. Classical texts urge care with risky behaviour and hidden health issues. Transformation comes through facing fears.

entries.title: Rahu in the 9th house
entries.body: Rahu in the house of dharma brings an unconventional belief system, questioning of tradition and foreign teachers or travel. It may bring friction with the father or orthodox authorities. Genuine seeking beyond dogma is its gift.

entries.title: Rahu in the 10th house
entries.body: Rahu in the house of career is a strong signature of ambition and public rise, often in technology, media, politics or foreign-related work. Success can be sudden. Ethical conduct keeps the rise from turning into a fall.

entries.title: Rahu in the 11th house
entries.body: Rahu in the house of gains is classically among its best placements. It gives large ambitions fulfilled, gains from unconventional sources or foreign networks, and influential friends. Desires multiply, so discernment is needed.

entries.title: Rahu in the 12th house
entries.body: Rahu in the house of foreign lands and solitude favours settlement abroad and work in institutions or behind the scenes. Texts caution about hidden expenses and disturbed sleep. Spiritual practice and moderation channel it well.

entries.title: Ketu in the 1st house
entries.body: Ketu on the ascendant gives a detached, introspective and intuitive presence, sometimes unsure of identity. Spiritual depth, originality and past-life skill are its themes. Care with health concerns that are hard to diagnose is advised.

entries.title: Ketu in the 2nd house
entries.body: Ketu in the house of wealth and speech gives detachment from accumulation, unusual or blunt speech and distance from family traditions. Classical readings urge care with speech and diet. Spiritual knowledge can become a real asset.

entries.title: Ketu in the 3rd house
entries.body: Ketu in the upachaya 3rd house is traditionally favourable. It gives courage without ego, intuitive communication and spiritual effort. Relations with siblings may be distant. Skill comes almost effortlessly.

entries.title: Ketu in the 4th house
entries.body: Ketu in the house of home can give a sense of not fully belonging, detachment from property or change of residence. Inner peace is sought through spirituality rather than possessions, and the home may become a place of retreat.

entries.title: Ketu in the 5th house
entries.body: Ketu in the house of intelligence gives a deep, intuitive, sometimes unconventional intellect and aptitude for mantra, astrology or research. Texts note concerns or detachment regarding children. Past merit expresses itself in spiritual insight.

entries.title: Ketu in the 6th house
entries.body: Ketu in the upachaya 6th house is classically strong. It gives victory over enemies, healing ability and resilience against disease. It supports alternative medicine and service without attachment to reward.

entries.title: Ketu in the 7th house
entries.body: Ketu in the house of partnership may bring detachment or unmet expectations in relationships, or a spiritual or unconventional partner. Relationships teach letting go of control. Business partnerships need clear terms.

entries.title: Ketu in the 8th house
entries.body: Ketu in the house of hidden matters is traditionally a strong placement for occult insight, research and moksha. Classical texts urge attention to sudden health events. Transformation comes naturally.

entries.title: Ketu in the 9th house
entries.body: Ketu in the house of dharma gives an intuitive, independent spirituality and detachment from orthodox belief. Relations with the father or teachers may be distant. Wisdom comes from direct experience.

entries.title: Ketu in the 10th house
entries.body: Ketu in the house of career can bring changes of profession or detachment from status. It suits technical, research or spiritual work done without craving recognition. Excellence comes from focus on the work itself.

entries.title: Ketu in the 11th house
entries.body: Ketu in the house of gains is traditionally favourable: gains come without much craving, friendships are few but meaningful, and desires are fulfilled in unexpected ways. Spiritual aspirations grow.

entries.title: Ketu in the 12th house
entries.body: Ketu in the house of liberation is classically considered one of its best placements. It gives a strong spiritual inclination, meditation, detachment and the classical signature for moksha. Expenses may go to spiritual pursuits.
